Storm Damage

We Help Manage Your Insurance Claim

If a storm damaged your roof, filing an insurance claim can be confusing. Here's how we help, start to finish.

01

Free Damage Inspection

We inspect the roof, document damage with photos, and give you an honest read on whether it's claim-worthy.

02

File & Schedule the Adjuster

We help you open the claim and coordinate scheduling directly with your insurance adjuster.

03

Adjuster Meeting

Our crew lead meets the adjuster on-site to make sure every damaged area is accounted for in the estimate.

04

Scope Review

We review the insurance estimate line by line and request supplements for anything missed.

05

Install & Final Paperwork

Once approved, we schedule the install and handle final invoicing directly with your carrier.

What to Have Ready

Having these on hand before the adjuster visit speeds the claim up significantly:

  • Your homeowner's policy number
  • Date of the storm event (we can help confirm this)
  • Any interior leak photos or water stains
  • Your deductible amount
  • Adjuster contact info, once assigned

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need my roof repaired or replaced? +

Signs like water leaks, missing shingles, sagging sections, and ceiling stains indicate a need for repair. We offer inspections to determine whether your roof needs replacement or repair.

What types of roofing materials do you install? +

We install asphalt shingles, metal, flat roofing systems like EPDM and TPO, and premium options like slate and clay tile.

How long does it take to install a roof? +

It depends on roof size, material, and job complexity. Most residential roofs take 1–3 days, while larger or more complex jobs take longer.

Are your services under warranty? +

Yes — we provide both material and workmanship warranties. Actual terms depend on the project, and we provide details upfront.

Can I get a free estimate? +

Absolutely. Call us today or fill out our contact form to schedule a free, no-obligation consultation and estimate.
